title: All hail your 2023 World Champions!

themes.title: Champion balance
themes.description: 8 champion buffs, 1 nerfs in this patch (excluding pure bugfixes).

summary: All hail your 2023 World Champions! Structured changes across 21 entities this patch.

champions.name: Azir
champions.tldr: Base health regeneration increased to 5 from 3.5.; Base armor increased to 25 from 22.
champions.gameplayImpact: Azir is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.

lines.label: Base health regeneration
lines.note: Base health regeneration increased to 5 from 3.5.

Immobilize an enemy champion generates 25 stacks of Reverberation for 8 seconds, stacking up to 100 times. At maximum stacks and upon immobilize an enemy, your on-hit effects are applied to them 3 times; additionally, you activate Rumble.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Old Effect: Basic attacks on-hit deal 10|magic damage (+ 1% of your bonus health) bonus magic damage. Additionally, upon taking damage from a basic attack or ability, generate 5 stacks of Reverberation for 6 seconds (3 second cooldown per enemy ability). Immobilize an enemy champion applies your on-hit effects to them 3 times and generates 25 stacks of Reverberation for 6 seconds. Reverberation stacks up to 100 times, at which you activate Rumble.
